BiblicalUsage: Once, in Isaiah's judgment on the daughters of Zion, who walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet. The word is the tinkling — anklets worn to draw the eye and the ear.
TheologicalSignificance: One tinkling anklet in one verse carries no theology; its weight is Isaiah's judgment, that God sees the show and will strip it away.
